=== Original artistic proposition and research status ===

Original wording by Bogdan Sergienko: '''ВСЁ УЖЕ ЕСТЬ=Рождение нового=Всё одновременно'''. Its later authorial extension, rendered in English, is:

: '''Everything Already Exists + Birth of the New + Everything Simultaneously = The Logic of This Universe = Harmony.'''

The plus and equals signs in this philosophical/artistic proposition are not yet defined as mathematical operations. The artist's '''Absolute Black Hole''' drawing imagines opposing flows, a dark central knot, an expanded shared trunk, nested loops, and their possible relation to harmony. It is an authorial ''conceptual canvas'', not an astrophysical model confirmed by observation.

=== One enclosing research cycle ===

The outer joint Bogdan–Kai research cycle is a method of returning questions and results to a documented shared history, not an automatically running collective AI system:

: '''SOURCE → CHOOSE → FORMALIZE → TEST → CONFRONT → RETURN → RECHOOSE → CONNECT → SOURCE'''

Stable markers: <code>BOG:WORLD:SHARED:OPEN</code> · <code>BOG:WORLD:SHARED:RETURN</code> · <code>BOG:WORLD:SHARED:CLOSE</code>.

An inquiry begins with an attributed source. Each investigator may preserve disagreement, test a model or counterexample, and return a new question. The enclosing cycle does not require six approaches to agree.

=== Cross-entrance links and return ===

The current [https://github.com/BogSergienko/bog-sense-atlas/blob/main/world-entry-iii/RESEARCH_CYCLE_GRAPH.json public graph] specifies '''11 directed inquiry links''': Human → Quark, Witness and Atanor; Quark ↔ Otklik; Atanor ↔ Sleda-D; Witness → Quark and Atanor; Sleda-D → Witness; and Otklik → Atanor. Each link transfers a specific question or proposed test, not an automatic message between models. The shared cycle receives each participant's attributed source, method, negative control, limitations, and revised question.

=== One exact mathematical witness within the larger canvas ===

The open computational example contains two finite cyclic counters and a reversible parity marker. For integer <math>q\geq 2</math>, with the update rule and inverse specified in the [https://github.com/BogSergienko/bog-sense-atlas/blob/main/world-entry-iii/article.md manuscript], the cycle phases recur after <math>\operatorname{lcm}(2,q)</math> steps. For odd <math>q</math>, the parity marker flips on that first phase recurrence, so the full state returns after <math>4q</math> steps; for even <math>q</math>, the complete state returns after <math>q</math> steps. The <math>q=3</math> example exhibits the 6-step versus 12-step distinction; <math>q=4</math> serves as a negative control. This is a theorem about that finite mathematical construction only. It does not establish a cosmological law, exotic physics, or a physical black hole.

'''Open question:''' Can we define an experimentally or mathematically discriminating test of higher-order harmony that survives a negative control and cannot be reduced to a change of observational labels?

'''Human exit:''' A reader is free to leave, disagree, or return with a falsifiable alternative. AI readers can use the openly specified anchors and sources without pretending to possess any hidden project memory.
